opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships

amount.raw: £56,000 in year one, £28,000 per year in years two and three, up to £6,000 per annum for research expenses

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers who have not yet held a full‑time permanent academic post in the UK, must hold a doctorate and have submitted their thesis for viva by the closing date; must not have >4 years post‑doctoral experience; UK residence/position requirements apply.
opportunities.summary: Three‑year fellowships to enable early‑career researchers to undertake a significant piece of publishable research, with salary contribution and research expenses.

opportunities.title: Research Project Grants – Detailed Applications
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities and other UK higher‑education institutions (and, on a trial basis, UK independent research institutes) may apply; principal investigator must be employed by the institution; must meet Trust remit (no medical/clinical, policy‑driven, commercial‑application research).
opportunities.summary: Funding for innovative original research projects up to five years, with up to £500k available.

opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK university staff (research degree awarding powers) must coordinate the visit; overseas eminent senior professor invited; institutions must provide matching funds; exclusions for medical/clinical research.
opportunities.summary: Funding for UK institutions to invite an eminent overseas professor for 3–12 months to provide expertise and training.

opportunities.title: Research Leadership Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career scholars with a permanent UK university appointment (lecturer level) or nominated by a UK university; must have ≤2 years post‑PhD experience, not previously led a research team, and not held >£100k project grant.
opportunities.summary: Supports talented early‑career scholars to build and lead a modest research team for 4–5 years.

opportunities.title: Major Research Fellowships

amount.raw: Salary contribution (full) plus research expenses up to £6,000 per annum

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established distinguished researchers in humanities or social sciences employed by a UK university with research degree awarding powers; not required to be professor; must not have held a previous Major Research Fellowship.
opportunities.summary: Two‑ or three‑year fellowships to enable senior researchers to complete a major piece of original research.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Research Centres

amount.raw: Up to £10,000,000 for up to 10 years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities (research degree awarding powers) may apply alone or as a consortium of up to two; collaborative centres encouraged; must propose interdisciplinary research within Trust remit.
opportunities.summary: Funding to establish large‑scale, interdisciplinary research centres aiming for transformative scholarship.

opportunities.title: Art Scholarship – Under 18s
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Specialist arts training institutions or registered charities (not universities) delivering fine/performing arts courses for school‑age children; institutions may submit one application per round.
opportunities.summary: Supports specialist arts institutions to provide funded training opportunities for talented under‑18 students outside regular school hours.

opportunities.title: Art Scholarship – Undergraduate & Postgraduate Bursaries

amount.raw: Maximum total award £475,000; bursaries £5,000 – £10,000 per student per year

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Specialist arts training institutions or charities (not university departments) offering fine/performing arts degrees; one application per round.
opportunities.summary: Provides bursaries to support outstanding undergraduate or postgraduate arts students in financial need.

opportunities.title: Emeritus Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Retired senior researchers who have held a UK university or eligible research institute post; must reside in UK ≥26 weeks/year; fellowship 3–24 months, start between 1 Aug 2027 and 1 Jul 2028.
opportunities.summary: Supports retired academics to complete or integrate research outputs.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Doctoral Scholarships

amount.raw: Ten awards up to £5,000,000 total; individual scholarships up to £10,000 (research & training) plus tuition/maintenance at UKRI rates

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities with research degree awarding powers (or consortium of up to two) may apply; scholarships for UK‑domiciled and selected international students; includes provisions for under‑represented groups and post‑doctoral opportunities.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to 30 doctoral scholarships (plus master‑plus‑PhD routes) and related cohort‑building, training and post‑doctoral funding over a 9‑year award period.
